events.headline: IRAN WAR LIVE: TEHRAN OFFERS US PLAN TO REOPEN HORMUZ WITHIN SEVEN DAYS
events.detail: Iran's FM says the "choice rests with the US" to approve the proposed seven-day proposal to reopen Hormuz.
